name: Constructor record-map geometry fields lose the selected source producer
mechanism: The canonical mapped constructor already contains a nominal record-field reference to the exact map binder. Geometry alias lowering stops at recordCollectionIndex unless a literal member exists, losing the map body and its source occurrence. Follow existing collection products and mapped-record bodies in the defining namespace, substituting the selected source record for the binder. No geometry evaluator or root scheduler is added.

name: Optional-record collection elements skip inline constructor analysis and nominal enrichment
mechanism: Both inline constructor discovery and generic collection admission test only element.kind record, so Box?[] rejects a Box constructor although T is assignable to T?. Unwrap only for canonical record identity/member analysis, retain the optional element wrapper and original ordinal. The reference-only counterfactual already passes on Base.

name: Indexed optional-record match loses its nominal selected binder and presence producer
mechanism: The early record shell cannot retain a collection-index scrutinee and the Module owner therefore reparses its some binder as an unavailable record. Resolve the optional element nominal identity at the existing Module owner, preserve explicit-none ordinals, use existing singleton-record presence and canonical selected-member aliases. Retain occurrence-specific IDs through Module arguments and register their cardinality/forwarding descriptors. Bounds use the existing typed collection-index evaluator. These downstream parameter, none, conditional-member and bounds symptoms belong to this same initially rejected indexed-optional form, not extra Base-independent families.
firstIncorrectOwners: packages/nui-language/src/scalars/moduleScalarRuntime.ts: selected singleton IDs, member resolver reuse and optional collection forwarding

name: Indexed whole-record exports omit the singleton producer required by their field projections
mechanism: Base accepts the record index and can compute scalar fields through an alternate field path, yet exported whole-record field projections point at an absent record-value producer. Emit the exact selected singleton by reusing its original record alias or existing lazy field declarations; fall back to the existing lazy record-map descriptor when fields lack declarations. The minimal reducer has no geometry or optional values, independently separating this first loss from F31/F33.
